subject: Lab curriculum & staggered office hours plan for Acme rollout
messages:
From: Kara Liu <kara.liu@acme-retail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Morales <diego.morales@acme-retail.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lab curriculum + office hours for Redwood rollout

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Diego and I are finalizing the internal kickoff for the Acme pilot (starts the week of May 17) and we want to align on a short lab curriculum and office-hours cadence that scales across our teams. A few constraints from our side:

- We have engineers in PST and some product folks in CET.
- Preference for live sessions to be no longer than 60 minutes; recordings are a must.
- We want 1-2 asynchronous exercises per lab so folks can complete on their own time.

Can you send a proposed 4–6 week curriculum and a staggered office-hours schedule (times that cover both US and EU working hours)? Also include pointer to where you’ll store recordings and any one-page quick-start docs.

Appreciate a draft by EOD Tuesday if possible.

Best,
Kara Liu
Enablement Lead, Acme Retail
K: 415-555-0132

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kara Liu <kara.liu@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lab curriculum + office hours for Redwood rollout

Kara —

Thanks for the context. Attached is a first draft (lab-curriculum-v1.pdf) plus a calendar export with proposed staggered office hours (officehours-calendar.ics). High-level summary below:

1) Curriculum (6-week sprint):
   - Week 1: Quickstart & prompts primer (prework + 45-min live demo)
   - Week 2: Model selection & cost/perf tradeoffs (hands-on exercise)
   - Week 3: Integration patterns (API + batching patterns)
   - Week 4: Observability & rollouts (tracing + fallback policies)
   - Week 5: Scaling & caching (KV cache and prefix caching labs)
   - Week 6: Wrapping up + QA and next steps (capstone exercise)

2) Staggered office hours (proposal):
   - Mondays 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET — trainer-led, focused Q&A
   - Wednesdays 13:00 PST / 22:00 CET — deep tech drop-in (30 min)
   - Fridays 16:00 PST — weekly recap + recording release

3) Async playbook: we’ll publish one-pagers and short walkthrough recordings to the shared Drive (link below). The attached PDF includes session objectives and small exercises per week.

Open questions for you:
- Do you want captions/transcripts for recordings (we can enable auto-captions + human review for the capstone)?
- Any blackout dates for your org between May 17–June 30?

I’ll loop in Marissa to confirm recording ownership and Ben for trainer assignment.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwood.com]

Attachments: lab-curriculum-v1.pdf, officehours-calendar.ics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Kara Liu <kara.liu@acme-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lab curriculum + office hours for Redwood rollout

+1 on Hannah’s outline. A couple of practical notes from ops/training perspective:

- Trainer roster: I can lead Weeks 1 and 3; Marissa can own Weeks 2 and 4; we’ll bring an engineer for Week 5 deep-dive.
- Session format: 20–25 min demo + 25–30 min lab + 10–15 min Q&A.
- Recordings: we’ll record to our internal studio, post to Drive and generate speaker notes. Transcripts available via auto-diarization; can add captions on request.

I’ve added a short MVP lesson outline (MVP-lesson-outline.md) to the Drive folder and linked below. Also, HubSpot deal DL-4821 updated with the training plan.

Thanks — this looks great. Quick responses:

- Captions: yes please, captions and rough timestamps for key demos would be very helpful for our distributed team.
- Office hours: Can we bias toward Wed mornings PST (10:00) and Fri late afternoons PST (16:00) as primary fixtures, with the Monday evening CET slot kept optional? That aligns best with scheduling on our side.
- Recording retention: we’d like access for 90 days minimum; any objections?

If that works, I’m happy to lock in the May 17 start and circulate to our internal list.

Kara
